doc.title: Fill Weight Checks
doc.purpose: Keep every bottle at or above the label claim without giving product away.

roles.name: Line Lead
roles.does: Reacts to results outside the action limits.

roles.name: QA Technician
roles.does: Reviews the charts each shift and places product on hold.

references.as_written: WI-210 Filler Setup and Nozzle Check

parameters.quote: Once every hour, take 5 bottles in a row from the filler discharge.
Once every hour, take 5 bottles in a row from the filler discharge.
Verify the check scale with the 1 kg test weight at the start of every shift.

parameters.what: overfill trigger to tell the Line Lead
parameters.applies_to: average above target, two checks in a row
parameters.quote: Average above target by more than 4 g for two checks in a row: tell the Line Lead.

rules.topic: who may change the fill setpoint
rules.statement: Operators must not change the fill setpoint.
rules.quote: Operators must not change the fill setpoint.

rules.topic: who may change the fill setpoint
rules.statement: Only the Maintenance Technician changes the setpoint and the change is written on the chart.
rules.quote: Only the Maintenance Technician changes the setpoint, and the change is written on the chart.

rules.statement: The QA Technician places product on hold.
rules.quote: Reviews the charts each shift and places product on hold.

rules.statement: The Line Lead places all product since the last good check on hold.
rules.quote: Place all product since the last good check on hold as described in QP-315.
